assets.none: No asset yet. Generate something to get started.
assets.noneOfKind: No asset of this kind. Change the Type filter to see the rest of the project.
assets.countHint: Everything this list shows — the project, your library and the generations under way, filters included
assets.openProject: Open a project to see its assets.
assets.importHint: Link a video, audio or image file — it stays where it is

badge.to-pull: Changed in the library — to fetch
badge.remote-only: In your library — not on this disk

assets.describeHint: Name the chosen images from what the API sees in them
assets.pushHint: Uploads the selection to the Scenario library
assets.generatingHint: Generating — the asset will appear here once it finishes
assets.fetchHint: Double-click to fetch it into the project and open it
assets.fetchActionHint: Downloads this asset from your Scenario library into the open project
assets.extractTexturesHint: Takes the images inside this model out into the project, where they can be opened and painted on
assets.editPixelsHint: Opens this image in the Image space, where ⌘S writes it back over itself
assets.renameHint: Changes the name in this project; the one on the Scenario account stays as it is

ingest.noFfmpeg: Video preparation unavailable: no lighter copy, no waveform.

collection.moreHint: Shows the remaining filters and the display options
collection.fewerHint: Folds the filters away, to make room for the collection

documents.none: No document open. Generate or open an asset to get started.
documents.missing: This document is no longer open.
documents.saveBody: If you do not save them, they will be lost.
documents.deleteBody: The file is removed from the project folder. This cannot be undone.
documents.overwriteBody: Another application has written to this file since the studio read it. Saving now replaces those changes, and they will be lost.
documents.closeHint: Takes the tab off the bar; the document stays in the project
documents.closeOthersHint: Closes every other tab, one after another
documents.renameHint: Changes the document’s name everywhere it is written — its file included
documents.deleteHint: Removes the document from the project, its file included
documents.nameTooLong: That name is too long for a file.
documents.nameInvalid: That name holds a character a file name cannot carry.
documents.nameTaken: The project already holds a document of that name.

audio.takeRole: The take you are editing, before it goes into the edit
audio.noClip: Select a clip from the edit to work on it here, or drop a take.
audio.unreadable: This file could not be decoded.
audio.noSelection: Drag across the waveform to select

audioTools.cropHint: Bring the clip in the edit down to the selection
audioTools.fadeInHint: Rise from silence across the selection
audioTools.fadeOutHint: Fall to silence across the selection
audioTools.trimSilenceHint: Pull the clip in to what is not silence
audioTools.compareHint: Hear the source, without undoing anything
audioTools.applyHint: Create the edited asset and use it in the edit
audioTools.saveAsHint: Create an asset beside the source

project.occupiedTitle: Set up the project “{{folder}}” in this folder?
project.occupiedBody: This folder already holds files, and it will BECOME the project: the studio adds its “assets” and “documents” folders inside it, and everything you make lands there. Nothing already there is changed or moved.
project.openHint: Opens a project folder already made, with what it holds
project.switchHint: Open another project from this machine, or create one
project.useHint: Closes the open project and opens this one in its place
project.createHint: Pick a folder on disk: everything the studio produces is written there

dictation.noDevice: No microphone was found on this computer.

errors.modelDownloadFailed: The model could not be downloaded.
errors.modelChecksumMismatch: The downloaded model is damaged; it has been removed.

dictation.downloadHint: Once only: the model then stays on this machine
dictation.cancelDownloadHint: Stops the download; whatever was received is thrown away
dictation.openPrivacySettingsHint: Opens the system settings, at the microphone section
